description.content:
Get product funnel metrics for a given merchant and date range.
Returns metrics including clicks, add to carts, orders, and various rates.

Args:
    from_date: Start date for current period metrics
    to_date: End date for current period metrics
    merchant_id: Merchant ID to get metrics for
    offset: Number of records to skip (for pagination)
    order: Sort order for results (DESC or ASC)
    order_by: Field to sort by (d_score, clicks, add_to_carts, or orders)
    page_size: Number of records to return per page
